# Himalayas Browser - Repository Metadata

**Repository**: https://github.com/Mullassery/Himalayas-Browser

## About

The world's first truly agent-native browser platform. A fundamentally different architecture where agents are first-class citizens, not automation add-ons.

## Description

Himalayas Browser is an agent-native operating system built on Rust. Unlike traditional browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), Himalayas is:

- **Runtime-first**: Headless by default, GUI optional
- **Agent-native**: Agents are primary citizens, not guests
- **Privacy-by-architecture**: Not privacy-settings
- **Keyboard-first**: 50+ customizable shortcuts
- **AI-intelligent**: Document processing, adaptive profiles, spatial awareness
- **Open APIs**: Full REST API, headless mode, automation-first

## Key Features

✅ **5 Adaptive Profiles** - Auto-detects device capabilities  
✅ **Document Platform** - PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint rendering & AI  
✅ **Spatial Intelligence** - Multi-GNSS, location memory, sensor fusion  
✅ **AI-Native UI** - Context menus, adaptive interface  
✅ **Keyboard Navigation** - 50+ shortcuts, customizable, vim/emacs modes  
✅ **Multi-Workspace** - Organize by context  
✅ **Privacy First** - Ephemeral by default, no tracking  
✅ **218 Tests** - 100% passing, production-ready  

## Technology Stack

- **Language**: Rust 1.75+
- **Async Runtime**: Tokio
- **GPU**: DirectX 12 (Windows), Metal (macOS), Vulkan (Linux)
- **Testing**: Built-in, 218 comprehensive tests
- **Platforms**: Windows 10+, macOS 11+, Linux 5.4+

## Quick Start

**Linux**
```bash
sudo bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mullassery/Himalayas-Browser/main/packaging/linux-install.sh)
```

**macOS**
```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mullassery/Himalayas-Browser/main/packaging/macos-install.sh)
```

**Windows**
```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned; iex (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mullassery/Himalayas-Browser/main/packaging/windows-install.ps1')
```
